title: LSA Certification Practice Test
description: Comprehensive practice test for PEGA Lead System Architect exam. 100 questions covering expert-level topics.

questions.question: What is the recommended approach for enterprise-scale PEGA implementations?
options: Microservices architecture with PEGA DX API
questions.explanation: Microservices architecture with PEGA DX API provides scalability, flexibility, and modern integration patterns for enterprise implementations.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Pega Deployment Manager?
options: To automate application deployment across environments
questions.explanation: Deployment Manager automates application deployment across environments, supporting CI/CD practices and reducing deployment risks.

questions.question: Which approach is best for handling multi-tenant PEGA applications?
options: Use organization layering and data isolation
Single shared database with no separation
questions.explanation: Organization layering with data isolation provides secure multi-tenancy while maintaining shared infrastructure and reducing costs.

questions.question: What is the recommended strategy for PEGA application versioning?
options: Use ruleset versioning with minor and major versions
questions.explanation: Ruleset versioning with minor and major versions provides structured change management and supports parallel development.

questions.question: What is the purpose of PEGA's decisioning framework?
questions.explanation: PEGA's decisioning framework uses AI and business rules to provide personalized next-best-action recommendations in real-time.

questions.question: What is the recommended approach for PEGA cloud deployment?
options: Pega Cloud or containerized deployment on Kubernetes
questions.explanation: Pega Cloud or containerized deployment on Kubernetes provides scalability, reliability, and modern cloud-native architecture.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Guardrails score in PEGA?
options: To measure application quality and adherence to best practices
questions.explanation: The Guardrails score measures how well an application follows PEGA best practices, helping ensure maintainability and performance.

questions.question: What is split-schema architecture in PEGA?
options: Separating rules and data into different databases
questions.explanation: Split-schema separates rules and data into different databases, enabling better scalability, backup strategies, and performance optimization.

questions.question: What is the recommended pattern for external system integration?
questions.explanation: Service-oriented architecture with well-defined APIs provides loose coupling, maintainability, and scalability for integrations.

questions.question: What is the purpose of PEGA Constellation UI?
options: A modern, React-based UI framework for better UX
questions.explanation: Constellation UI is PEGA's modern, React-based UI framework that provides better performance, flexibility, and user experience.
